test_compare_axis: test the Series.compare method with align_axis parameter set to 0 or 1 to compare two Series objects
test_compare_various_formats: test the Series.compare method with keep_shape and keep_equal parameters to control output format
test_compare_with_equal_nulls: test the Series.compare method to verify two NaN values are considered equal and dropped
test_compare_with_non_equal_nulls: test the Series.compare method to verify mismatched NaN values are not dropped
test_compare_multi_index: test the Series.compare method with MultiIndex indices to compare two Series with hierarchical labels
